{{Quote|Ragnos? What can a dead Sith Lord give you?''"<br />"''Everything I have ever wanted.|[[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Tavion Axmis]]|<ref name="jkja" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''conflict''' broke out in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] between the [[Disciples of Ragnos]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] splinter faction, and the [[New Jedi Order]] supported by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The cult led by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tavion Axmis]] tried to resurrect the ancient Sith Lord [[Marka Ragnos]], believing that he would give them unlimited power and bring the galaxy under their control. Eventually, their plans were thwarted, mostly due to the actions of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]], and they were defeated in a [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|battle]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Thanks to you, the weakling Jedi who scorned me shall soon be erased from history, replaced by a new race of warriors; strong warriors, warriors who know that the Force is not a shield to protect the useless&hellip; but is, in reality, a weapon&hellip; to empower the worthy!|Desann to [[Kyle Katarn]]|<ref name="jo">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Taviondesann.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Tavion Axmis and Desann]]
In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|Dr.]] [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antillies]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] chief consultant on recovering dangerous artifacts, warned that there was still an untold number of galaxy-threatening [[The Force/Legends|Force]] artifacts that were unaccounted for. She also believed that the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Dark side adept/Legends|adepts]] who evaded capture may have fled to [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]] to study in lost fortresses and libraries. She recommended that an expedition be sent to the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|tombs]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to learn more.<ref>{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>    

The crisis was born of the [[Empire Reborn]], an Imperial splinter movement led by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]], a former [[Procurator of Justice]] who dedicated his life to make his vision of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] a reality and rule it with cadres of fanatically loyal followers.<ref name="jkja" /><ref name="dfs">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref><ref name="cs">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref> To achieve his long-dreamt goal, he tasked [[Desann]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] and second-in-command of the Empire Reborn project, with creating a Dark Army.<ref name="dfs" /> Recruiting [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] members from the [[Empire Youth]] and other minions of Lord Hethrir, the [[Chistori]] Dark Jedi established the [[Reborn]] - an organization of warriors artificially imbued or enhanced with the Force.<ref name="dfs" /><ref name="cs" /><ref name="jo" />

However, [[Kyle Katarn]] managed to kill Desann at the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Empire Reborn)|Battle of Yavin IV]] and the newly-created army of the Empire Reborn were decimated by the combined forces of the New Republic and [[New Jedi Order]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="jo" /> Lord Hethrir met his end two years later, consumed by a trans-dimensional being called [[Waru]].<ref name="cs" /> The death of the key members of the Empire Reborn dealt a devastating loss to the movement.<ref name="jo" /> Those Reborn who survived rallied under [[Tavion Axmis]], Desann's apprentice, whose life Katarn had spared on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="jkja" /><ref name="jo" />

Tavion, established a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] and Imperial splinter force called the [[Disciples of Ragnos]], and henceforth the Reborn serving Tavion were now known as the [[New Reborn]]. Before that Tavion had took sadistic [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]] as her apprentice and found an ancient Sith artifact on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]], known as the [[Scepter of Ragnos]], which could siphon Force energies from locations that possessed some residue of Force power, known as [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexuses]]. The scepter was instrumental in empowering many individuals wth Force energy, the so-called [[Sith cultist/Legends|Sith Cultists]], which made the majority of the Disciples of Ragnos. The final goal of the cult was to resurrect one of the most respectable [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] all the time, [[Marka Ragnos]], thus issuing a new era of Sith rule.<ref name="jkja" />

==Cult emergence==
{{Quote|We'll have to investigate any locations from my records. That includes all of you students.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="jkja" />}}
[[File:StudentGathering.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Luke Skywalker briefing a gathering of New Jedi Order students.]]
Tavion, having the powerful cult with strict rules and clear hierarchy under her command, established trade contacts with influential [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and bosses of the [[Invisible Market]], including [[Lannik Racto]], a dangerous [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The cult leader hoped that her connections in the underworld would further destabilize the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government who was allied to the [[New Jedi Order]] founded by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. After accumulating enough manpower and wealth she started dispatching her cultists to various regions of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] ordering them to find places that possessed some residue of Force power, especially the planets being tainted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Alora and [[Kothos twins]], extremely skilled in using the Force powers members of the cult, were trusted by their leader with responsibility over these missions.<ref name="jkja" />

Finally, Tavion and her disciples made a daring move, carrying out a [[Yavin 4 Incursion|surprising infiltration]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], during which they drained Force power from one of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Temples]] and stole valuable data from Luke Skywalker's [[Jedi Praxeum]]. This attack brought the cult's existence to light and due to bravery of [[Jaden Korr]], the new student famous for construction of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] even before attending the Jedi Academy, the Jedi Order was informed about the growing threat to the galaxy. Luke Skywalker quickly formed many Jedi task forces consisting of experienced [[Jedi Master/Legends|masters]]/[[Jedi Knight/Legends|knights]], including [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], and promising padawans. He sent them on many missions in order to prevent the Disciples of Ragnos from executing their schemes. The headmaster of the Academy also contacted the New Republic authorities, asking their officials and agents to help the Jedi to track down and halt the cultists. Jaden Korr and his newly-met friend [[Rosh Penin]] were assigned to Kyle Katarn and instructed to take part in this broad-based intelligence operation.<ref name="jkja" />

==The hunt for the Cult==
[[File:Korr_Katarn_Penin.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Korr, Katarn and Penin.]]
{{Quote|We're investigating a cult that's been cropping up everywhere.|[[Jaden Korr]] to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="jkja" />}}
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] knew that the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] would attempt to possess Force powers present on the worlds catalogued in his personal records. However, it was also crucial for the Jedi Order to find out who was backing the Disciples of Ragnos. As a result, long range reconnaissance was undertaken all over the whole known galaxy. The most important ones were carried out by [[Jaden Korr]] and his master, [[Kyle Katarn]] in the following places:<ref name="jkja" />

*[[Mission to Mos Eisley (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Mos Eisley]] - while investigating smuggling activity Katarn and Korr discovered connections between the smugglers/mercenaries and the cult. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], being there on diplomatic business, helped the Jedi defeat the criminals.<ref name="jkja" />
*[[Mission to Tatooine (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Tatooine]] - Katarn went to talk to a [[Unidentified Tatooine moisture farmer|moisture farmer]] who overheard a conversation about the Disciples of Ragnos in a local bar. In the meantime, Korr extracted the [[R5-D2|R5 unit]] which had been sold to [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] attacked by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. The droid was priceless, because it had recorded the entire conversation.<ref name="jkja" />
*[[Mission to Corellia (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Corellia]] - having received worrisome reports from [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] Kyle and Jaden decided to check them out personally. They encountered mercenaries cooperating with some [[Sith cultist/Legends|Sith Cultists]], who attempted to sabotage a [[Hovertrain/Legends|maglev train]]. Both Jedi fully thwarted their evil plans.<ref name="jkja" />
*[[Mission to Hoth (Jaden Korr)|Hoth]] - Korr was chosen to make certain that the area on the desolate world, where Luke Skywalker talked to the [[Force ghost/Legends|ghost]] of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] many years ago, was not siphoned of Force energies. The worst fears were proved when Jaden discovered that [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] and Sith cultists had went on ahead of the Jedi Order. Nevertheless at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] Korr decimated the enemy forces and survived the duel with Axmis's apprentice, [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]], forcing her to flee. After completing this mission Korr was promoted to the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Apprentice]] and Skywalker found out that [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] listed in Echo Base database would be the next target for the cult.<ref name="jkja" />
*[[Mission to the Valley of the Jedi|Ruusan]] - being very well acquainted with the [[Valley of the Jedi]] Kyle went to look at this place, which was known as a very powerful and sacred [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]]. Therefore its protection from the Cult of Ragnos was top priority for the Luke Skywalker's Jedi Order.<ref name="jkja" />
*[[Mission to Zonju V|Zonju V]] - Padawan Korr was supposed to meet a [[Unidentified spaceport worker|spaceport worker]], who had gained important information on the Disciples of Ragnos, however the contact was assassinated before he could reveal anything. Jaden, being attacked without a break by swoop mercenaries hired by the cult, had to resort to escape.<ref name="jkja" />
*[[Mission to Kril'Dor|Kril'dor]] - [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] (NRI) agents provided information about the gas platform supplying the Disciples of Ragnos with funds obtained from the sale of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] mined from the giant gas planet. The joint operation between commanding officer [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and Jaden Korr allowed the New Republic to defeat Imperial forces and secure the tibanna gas platform.<ref name="jkja" />
*[[Second mission to Coruscant (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Coruscant]] - eliminating funding sources of the cult was as important as preventing Force siphoning by their members, so New Republic contacted the Jedi Order to capture [[Lannik Racto]], a [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] and one of the main financial backers of the Cult of Ragnos, who supplied them with illegal [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] through the [[Invisible Market]]. Chosen for this mission Korr localized Racto's headquarters, found an alternative way inside it, defeated all security guards and arrested the host. After being apprehended Racto revealed to New Republic authorities the site of his [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] [[Nar Shaddaa droid factory|droid factory]] and within days a team of NRI agents [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|shut it down]].<ref name="jkja" />
*[[Mission to Dosuun|Dosuun]] - upon investigating transmissions about the cult activity Jaden Korr fell into the trap set by [[Rax Joris]], a corrupt [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] officer, who founded a prison compound on the remote world and occasionally played sick "hide and run" games with prisoners. The apprentice of Kyle Katarn was forced to participate in one of these 'special entertainment shows', but managed to survive to the end. In the hangar, where his [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] was stationed, Korr killed Joris, reclaiming his stolen lightsaber.<ref name="jkja" />

There were also missions with other participants. [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] [[Mission to Wayland|made a journey]] to [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] to investigate cult or Imperial Remnant presence on the planet. [[Streen]] and [[Tionne Solusar]], a scholar of Jedi history, were also involved in the hunt for the cult with the second one providing invaluable knowledge about places strong in the Force. Before Korr's visit to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], another student of Kyle Katarn, [[Rosh Penin]] was sent to [[Mission to Byss (Rosh Penin)|look around]] the remains of the planet, but was kidnapped by the cult and turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], becoming the second apprentice of Tavion Axmis.<ref name="jkja" />

==Side missions==
[[File:Fett_Korr.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jaden Korr fighting Boba Fett on Ord Mantell.]]
In-between the missions related to the Sith cult activity, the New Jedi Order had to perform their daily duties, especially by participation in resolving various conflicts and problems erupting in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. On [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], Korr on request of local authorities [[Mission to Bakura (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|investigated]] a [[Bakuran power station|power station]] which was not answering any calls. It turned out that the station had been sabotaged by [[Disciples of Ragnos]] forces and selected it to be used to cause a great disaster in a nearby city. The [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] managed to prevent this tragedy on his own even before his master showed up. During the [[mission to Blenjeel]], Korr was tasked to rescue crewmembers of crashed [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] vessel, unfortunately all of them had been killed by local dangerous wild beasts, [[sand burrower]]s with the last survivor eaten in front of Korr. Due to Jaden's reports, the New Republic classified [[Blenjeel]] as a dangerous world in its [[New Republic Galactic Database|database]]. The talented Jedi, assisted by his master, who was looking for Penin at this time, also [[Mission to Nar Kreeta|rescued]] [[Mining Guild elders]] on [[Nar Kreeta]], preventing their death at the hands of a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] at a gambling arena owned by a [[Unidentified Hutt crime lord (Nar Kreeta)|local Hutt crime lord]].<ref name="jkja" />
